content.text: The verifier's substantive review confirms the finding on every point; the only "failure" is an inapplicable heuristic sub-check. I'll re-submit the compliant finding unchanged in substance, with the inapplicability stated up front.

input.quote: The relationship of the Parties is that of independent contractors, and nothing herein is intended, nor should be construed, to create a partnership, agency, joint venture or employment relationship.
input.rationale: No non-solicit clause exists, so the sub-checks for duration and a general-solicitation carve-out are inapplicable rather than failed. Searches for "solicit", "non-solicitation", "hire", "employ or engage", "induce", "recruit", "poach", "personnel" and "directly or indirectly" return no non-solicitation, no-hire or anti-poaching covenant anywhere in the agreement. The only employment-adjacent provisions are the independent contractor/no-agency clause quoted above (p0066), the mutual indemnities (p0051/p0052) and confidentiality handling by employees (p0061); none restricts either party from soliciting or hiring the other's personnel. Our preferred NOSOLICIT position is that no non-solicit bind the Customer, and that position is met by this absence, so no redline and no counterparty comment are warranted and the paragraph stands unchanged. Internal note only, not to be raised with Kubient: if Kubient later proposes a non-solicit, we would require it to be mutual, limited to personnel directly involved in the services, capped at 12 months from the end of their involvement, with carve-outs for general advertisements and unsolicited approaches, and with no "no-hire".
